faq.описание_одноразовой_ссылки: A one-time link is a unique link that is used only once. Once the link has been used or has expired, it becomes invalid. It's an ideal way to securely transfer data or access information.
faq.описание_хранения_истории: History is stored in your browser, so information about link activities is only accessible from the device where they were performed. Only you can see your history.
faq.как_долго_действует_одноразовая_ссылка: How long does a one-time link last?
faq.описание_срока_действия: You can choose a link duration from 5 minutes to 1 year. This allows you to customize the link for any needs, whether it's for temporary information transfer or long-term access.
faq.можно_ли_защитить_ссылку_паролем: Can a link be password protected?
faq.описание_защиты_паролем: Yes! Each link can be password protected for added security. Only someone who knows the password can use the link.
faq.описание_безопасности_данных: All data on our server is stored in encrypted form. This means that even if someone gains access to the server, they cannot decrypt your data without the key.
faq.что_происходит_когда_срок_действия_истек: What happens when a link expires?
faq.описание_истечения_срока: Once the link expires, it is automatically deleted and becomes inaccessible. This ensures that the information does not fall into the hands of third parties.
faq.для_чего_можно_использовать_одноразовые_: What can one-time links be used for?
faq.описание_использования:
One-time links are perfect for:
 - Securely transferring confidential documents.
 - Temporary access to personal data.
 - Time-limited access to online resources.
 - Remote transfer of passwords, tokens, and other sensitive information.
faq.сколько_ссылок_можно_создать: How many links can be created?
faq.описание_количества_ссылок: The number of links is unlimited. You can create as many links as you need.
faq.какие_технологии_используются_для_шифров: What technologies are used for data encryption?
faq.описание_технологий_шифрования: We use advanced encryption algorithms, such as AES-256, to ensure maximum protection of your data.
faq.что_будет_если_кто-то_попытается_взломат: What happens if someone tries to hack the link?
faq.описание_взлома: Without your password for the link, an intruder will not succeed.
faq.можно_ли_изменить_пароль_или_срок_действ: Can the password or link duration be changed?
faq.описание_изменения_параметров: No, once the link is created, its parameters cannot be changed. This is done to maintain its one-time and secure nature.
faq.как_быстро_создаётся_ссылка: How quickly is a link created?
faq.описание_создания_ссылки: Creating a link takes just a few seconds. You simply set the parameters, and the link is ready to use.
